# spo_storage_entity (Resource)

Manages a SharePoint tenant storage entity / farm property bag value (Set/Get/Remove-SPOStorageEntity, CSOM). Identity is "<site-url>|<key>" — the site (usually the tenant app catalog) and the entity key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Tenant storage entities (farm property-bag values) are written on the app
# catalog site. The identity is "<site-url>|<key>".
resource "spo_storage_entity" "brand_color" {
  identity    = "https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/appcatalog|BrandPrimaryColor"
  value       = "#0078d4"
  description = "Corporate primary brand colour"
  comment     = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.
- `value` (String) The storage entity value.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) The storage entity comment.
- `description` (String) The storage entity description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
